anomalies.description: A small dark object is seen in mid-air just above the tank barrel in frame f6 (47.0 s), consistent with a projectile being fired or launched from the tank shortly before the explosion; no muzzle flash visible but trajectory suggests launch event.
A large, violent explosion erupts from a ground target, producing a massive fireball, dense smoke plume, and debris ejection; the fireball expands rapidly and begins to collapse over this interval.
A large, violent explosion erupts from a vehicle on the ground, producing a bright orange fireball and a plume of dark smoke; debris is visibly ejected upward.

A tank is visible stationary in an open field (f11–f13), then struck by an explosive impact (f14–f15), consistent with active combat engagement; the sequence implies hostile action against a military vehicle.

A large, violent explosion originates from a tracked military vehicle (likely a tank) in an open field, producing a rapidly expanding fireball, dense black and grey smoke, and high-velocity fragmentation of the vehicle's structure. The blast progresses from initial ignition to near-total vaporization of the vehicle over ~7.5 seconds.
A second distinct explosion occurs on a tank, with a bright white-yellow fireball engulfing the vehicle’s turret area, indicating a direct hit and catastrophic detonation.

A large, violent explosion with a bright white/yellow fireball expanding rapidly, producing a dense plume of reddish-orange and gray smoke and ejecting multiple fragments (debris or shrapnel) outward at high velocity. The blast evolves over time: initial overexposure and fragmentation (f0–f3), peak expansion and debris dispersion (f4–f10), and gradual decay with smoke dominance (f11–f15).; A large, violent explosion with a bright fireball, rapidly expanding smoke plume, and visible debris ejection; the blast evolves over time with sustained fire and fragmentation.

A large, sustained explosion with intense orange-yellow fireball, expanding smoke plume, and visible debris/fragments ejected outward; the blast evolves over time with decreasing intensity but remains clearly explosive throughout the sequence.

A large, violent explosion with a rapidly expanding fireball, dense smoke plume, and numerous incandescent fragments ejected outward. The blast evolves from an initial bright flash to a sustained, turbulent fireball with rising smoke and debris over the 7.5-second interval.

A large, intense explosion with a bright fireball, expanding smoke plume, and ejection of debris and sparks; the blast evolves over time with sustained fire and fragmentation visible across all frames.
